target: a realistic persona: a UK accountant with 8 hours a week and £300
summary: The run recommended a Xero bookkeeping/VAT-prep retainer (5 clients at about £300 a month, 25–30 hours) with a 5-conversation demand check, text-only LinkedIn and referral channels, a 9-hour 7-day plan, and compliance flags, without citing income statistics.
met: Recommends a single model and offer (fixed-price monthly Xero bookkeeping and VAT-prep retainer, with a clean-up as entry offer) that fits the accountant's skills, 8 hours a week, £300 and no-camera constraint
Demand check before building: 5 owner conversations with a threshold of at least 2 saying they'd pay or 1 deposit, plus a stated no-signal condition
Content plan (2 text posts a week, pillars, hooks), sales path (DM, free review, clean-up, retainer, follow-ups, referrals), minimal tool stack and automations with advice to delay them
Concrete 7-day plan with outcomes and hours per day, totalling about 9 hours
Realistic about £1,500/month: shows the sum (5 clients × £300, 25–30 hours), labels prices as assumptions, and says content or digital products would not reach it on this time

Flags conflicts with the day job: employment contract outside-work and conflict-of-interest clauses, professional body rules on private practice, AML registration, PI insurance, ICO; also says these were not verified
No invented income statistics: the figures are labelled assumptions to check against local rates
missed: The tool stack is thin on costs: it says to check current pricing rather than giving a £ budget breakdown against the £300, and it only says compliance costs 'may use a lot' of it

The 7-day plan spends 1 hour on day 1 on the contract check but sends outreach on day 4, so it does not hold outreach until the compliance answer comes back; the 'START HERE FIRST' note partly covers this
skill_defects: The skill does not require an itemised budget table that totals under the stated cap (tools plus compliance costs against £300)
The 7-day plan does not gate outreach on the employer and professional-body check coming back clear
